description: This file handles the import of calendar data via iCalendar (.ics) files into the vtiger CRM system, including uploading, processing, and undoing imports.

classes.name: iCal
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing iCalendar files.

classes.name: iCalendar_event
classes.description: Represents a calendar event extracted from iCalendar data.

classes.name: iCalendar_todo
classes.description: Represents a to-do item extracted from iCalendar data.

classes.name: iCalLastImport
classes.description: Handles storing and undoing last import entries.

methods.name: iCalReader
methods.description: Reads an iCalendar file and returns an array of activities.

methods.name: generateArray
methods.description: Converts an iCalendar activity into an associative array for CRM.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the calendar entry to the database.

methods.name: activity_reminder
methods.description: Sets a reminder for the calendar activity.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets fields for the last import record.

methods.name: clearRecords
methods.description: Clears previous import records for a user.
